result:
If I could change the world in just one way, I would make universal access to high‑quality education a reality for every child, regardless of where they are born, their family’s income, gender, or any other circumstance.  

When people everywhere have the tools to learn to read, think critically, and solve problems, they gain the agency to improve their own lives, to innovate, to build healthier societies, and to collaborate across differences. Education is the seed that can simultaneously lift people out of poverty, empower informed civic participation, foster scientific and technological breakthroughs, and nurture the empathy needed to address the planet’s environmental challenges. In short, a world where no one is denied the chance to learn would set the foundation for tackling virtually every other systemic issue we face.
